reports.scope: Whole process including input read, normalization, sorted-map counting, ranking, printing and teardown. Input generation and compilation excluded. Timings use uninstrumented binaries; fresh-process RSS and fwp managed counters are separate. C/Rust implement only ASCII; input fixtures are ASCII. fwp also accepts UTF-8 text, with ASCII-only lowercasing. All materialize normalized words and use sorted contiguous key/count pairs. String/list layout, allocation growth, sorting and buffering implementations differ. C/Rust combine the three normalization passes; fwp may allocate intermediate strings. Managed counters exclude raw buffers, allocator metadata, stacks and process startup; they are not comparable to whole-process RSS. No C/Rust allocation counts are claimed. Ratios are per-host fwp median / peer median; all samples retained. Before variants recompile saved baseline C with this run's toolchain and flags. All six variants run in balanced order on this host; baseline counts must reproduce exactly. Candidate allocation requests/bytes must fall with no higher retains or managed peak. Timing is reported even when slower; no timing budget or language-wide speed claim is established.
